\caption{Harm-balanced controller against comparators tuned on held-out patients (tuned on even-numbered, scored on odd-numbered patients, $n = 500$ each). The controller is not tuned on outcomes: its doses follow from the phenotype's hazard coefficients, the patient's SOFA score and age, and a forecast of the drug-free seizure rate. Estimated: the forecast comes from an extended Kalman filter (EKF) whose measurement model includes the drug; its prior and persistence were chosen by tracking error on the tuning half (prior peak 10 seizures/day, persistence 5 days). Oracle: the true drug-free rate and the patient's own dose-response parameters. Entries: survival difference in percentage points with 95\% paired-bootstrap interval; the tuned setting is in brackets. Positive values favor the harm-balanced controller. Sz: seizure harm; Drug: drug harm. SOFA: Sequential Organ Failure Assessment. The controller ties the best tuned fixed dose when the drug is not harmful (where the maximum dose is optimal) and beats every tuned comparator when it is.}
